            What GTU asked

            • Summer 20267 marksSimilar method

              A prestressed rectangular concrete bam 200 mm wide and 600 mm deep is supporting a live load of 8kN/m over a span of 8 m. Find the effective prestressing force in the parabolic cable having an eccentricity of 80 mm at the center of span and concentric at the supports. Case 1) In this beam the bending effect of the prestressing force is nullified by the imposed load for the mid span section, neglecting self weight of the beam. Case 2) if the resultant force due to self weight, LL and prestressing force is zero at the soffit of the beam at the center of span section.

              Q1C · Numerical · PDF p. 1
            • Winter 20253 marksSimilar method

              A prestressed concrete beam has a rectangular cross-section of 500 x 800 mm and a span of 12 meters. It carries a uniformly distributed load of 25 kN/m, which includes its own self-weight. The beam is axially prestressed by a cable providing an effective force of 2000 kN, applied along the longitudinal centroidal axis. Determine the extreme fiber stresses in the concrete at the mid-span section.

              Q5A · Numerical · PDF p. 4
            • Summer 20257 marksSimilar method

              A simply supported prestressed concrete beam with 10 m span and a rectangular section of 600 x 900 mm is subjected to prestressing force of 5600 kN applied at an eccentricity of 200 mm below the centroid of the section. Find top and bottom fibre stresses at transfer and after application of live load 80 kN/m. Consider losses 15%. Draw stress distribution diagram at mid span for stresses at transfer stage and at the service stage.

              Q5C OR · Numerical · PDF p. 7
            • Summer 20247 marksSimilar method

              A rectangular concrete bam 230 mm wide and 320 mm deep is prestressed by a force of 400 kN at a constant eccentricity of 50 mm. The beam supports a concentrated load of 70kN at the centre span of 5 m. Determine the resultant stresses at center span and quarter span for the beam. Neglect the self-weight of the beam.

              Q1C · Numerical · PDF p. 10
            • Summer 20247 marksSimilar method

              A rectangular concrete beam of cross-section 32cm deep and 23cm wide is prestressed by means of 18 wires of 5mm diameter located 5 cm from the bottom of the beam and 4 wires of diameter of 5mm, 3 cm from the top. Assuming the prestress in the steel as 700 N/mm2, determine the stressed at the extreme fibers of the mid span sections when the beam is supporting its own weight over a span of 5 m. If a uniformly distributed live load of 8 kN/m is imposed, evaluate the maximum stress in concrete. The density of concrete is 24 kN/m3.

              Q3C OR · Numerical · PDF p. 10
            • Summer 20247 marksSimilar method

              A rectangular beam of span 6m and cross section 130mm wide x 350mm deep is prestressed by a straight cable with an effective prestressing force of 200 kN located at an eccentricity of 30mm. The beam carries a live load of 1.5 kN/m all over its span. Calculate the Magnitude of Prestressing force with an eccentricity of 30mm which can balance the stresses due to dead and live loads at the bottom fibre of the central section of the beam.

              Q5C OR · Numerical · PDF p. 11

            Answer Framework

            Book pp. 48–50 (Ex 9), 52–54 (Ex 12) · PDF pp. 26–27, 28–29

            1. Resultant stresses section 2.3: solve Example 9 (multiple wires, self-weight and live load) and Example 12 (constant eccentricity, point load at midspan).
            2. Use section properties, moments, stress signs and extreme fibre stresses.

                            Book and syllabus mapping

                            Original DPCS book.pdf (118 physical pages, scanned spreads) has six book chapters. GTU has five modules: Introduction (10% CO weight), Losses (15%), Flexural Design (35%), Shear and Torsion (20%), Compression and Tension (20%). Book Chapter 2 is an additional analysis chapter; it is not an extra GTU module. The PDF reference is the physical scan page, not the printed book page. Some scan pages are duplicated, omitted or single-page. The supplied book is not republished in this package.

                            Priority rules

                            Video IMP wording and order follow the screenshots; the supplied Gujarati transcript determines the emphasis. Most IMP = explicit video emphasis or historical direct/method matches in at least 3 papers, or 7 marks in at least 2 papers. Example matches are similar numerical methods, not necessarily identical numbers. Histogram counts each paper position once.

                            Verification limits

                            All 125 paper subquestions are retained (25 per paper including OR). Printed book and physical PDF page numbers are shown separately; the source is a scanned book with some duplicated/cropped or missing leaves. Exact example locations were checked against visible scans where legible; other reading windows are based on the index and existing scan references, not a full independent line-by-line verification. The supplied video transcript was reviewed; independent audio access was not performed. Concordant profile and non-distortional prestressing remain provisional: exact book location not found. Winter 2025 Q5 OR C retains the original RC beam wording. The Ch. 5 Example 3 printed input and solution differ; use exam inputs. No invented references.

                            Supplied scan begins with the syllabus/index, not a title page. Printed DPCS 2021 imprint is visible; author, edition and full cover details remain UNVERIFIED. Exact printed/PDF reading windows already present are preserved; the scan is not complete enough to certify continuity.

                            Syllabus coverage and gaps

                            Official unit order is distinct from video/book order. These are chapter-level mappings, not proof that each syllabus subtopic is covered. Follow the linked topic cards for individual PYQs, IMP status and reading pages. No unverified video or page number is invented.
